graph.name: Plan an open-ended NPC response
graph.description:
Plan an NPC response without assigning the player new dialogue, consent, feelings, or choices.

Lesson: Separate a bounded Context input, a zero-call selection step, a one-call plan, and the final Guidance budget. Actor ownership belongs in the plan's instructions.

Limitations: The plan is advisory to the native writer; this is not a semantic agency validator.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change Tessa's permitted action from lowering the barrier to calling a colleague; compare whether the player's answer stays open.
Change Keep recent from 2 to 3 and Target tokens from 1100 to 1500; inspect which earlier demands survive selection.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Situation: The guard demands an explanation. The player has not answered.

Direction: Have the guard wait or raise the stakes through her own action. Leave the player's answer and intent open.

Evidence and preparation: Inspect Checkpoint evidence, then Keep the unanswered demand. Context carries source identities; selection costs zero calls. Edit the six-message window before increasing model budgets.

Ownership and delivery: Inspect the plan, then Guidance. Analysis resolves locally; no profile or model is bundled. The native writer receives advice, so inspect the actual reply for agency preservation.

Checkpoint evidence (pre-scene)
Purpose: Read recent public exchanges and Tessa's character fields into Context; six messages keep the unanswered demand visible.
Fixture: Character: Tessa guards the night checkpoint and may lower its barrier. Chat: Tessa demands an explanation for the broken seal. The player has not answered. The player controls Rowan.
Inspect: Check message identities, character material and omissions. This source reads the host chat; the fixture is setup text, not an import-time injection.

Keep the unanswered demand (pre-focus)
Purpose: Select supplied Context deterministically using the recent-message protection, literal pins and token target; remove oldest nonmandatory messages first.
Inspect: Inspect retained messages and preservation report. The empty Pins list avoids requiring a literal phrase in every user's checkpoint scene; Output tokens is inactive for select. Purpose and the completion cap do not affect Select. Retention follows keepRecent, literal pins and oldest-message removal; semantic relevance belongs in a model-backed step.

Tessa acts; Rowan chooses (pre-plan)
Purpose: Turn selected Context into optional Guidance about an NPC-owned action and a clear stopping point.
Inspect: Expect a proposed Tessa action and an open Rowan response. Check that the plan never supplies Rowan's dialogue or treats an interpretation as an established fact.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Checkpoint writing direction (pre-guidance)
Purpose: Expose the plan as a bounded host result for this generation; the smaller budget encourages one usable beat.
Inspect: Inspect the labeled Guidance Host result. A manual Run previews it; an assigned enabled Pre workflow installs it on Send. Budget overflow fails instead of silently enlarging the brief.

pre-focus.title: Context Focus
pre-focus.purpose: Keep Tessa's demand, the broken seal, Rowan's last stated action, and the absence of a player answer. Do not summarize missing consent.

pre-plan.title: Response Plan
pre-plan.instructions: Plan the next checkpoint beat. Tessa is the NPC; the player owns Rowan. Produce short labeled directions: NPC action, Player boundary, Stop. Tessa may repeat the question, inspect the broken seal, or lower her own barrier. Choose one supported action. Leave Rowan's answer, intent, feelings, consent and next movement unwritten. An unanswered demand is not agreement. Stop after Tessa creates a concrete opportunity for Rowan to respond. Do not add evidence explaining the broken seal. Unspecified current staging is unknown. Do not presuppose the barrier's state, current relative positions, or new existing props. Phrase any new NPC movement explicitly as an optional proposal.
